scope: Camera source and Specimen & recipe geometry; new current-run summary chart
method: Impeccable native-interface polish and manual source/render audit adapted to Windows Qt Quick. No web detector or mobile-platform conformance claim.

context.engine: Context command could not create the personal engine cache in the sandbox; followed the documented direct-context fallback.
context.authority: Existing source, TechRequirement/design direction.md, shared palette and fresh native renders. PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md are absent.
context.preserved: Semantic light/dark colors, menus, lock switch, fixed-size menu, camera admission, evidence rules and latched defect alarm.

before: Specimen identity and recipe values did not share an explicit label/value grid.
Camera controls had little spare horizontal space for label/status separation.
No cumulative evidence-backed Pass/Fail/Review summary or yield distribution existed.
after: Equal-height setup cards; explicit camera label, 76-pixel specimen/recipe label column and 110-pixel recipe-action column.
Connection and recipe buttons share their vertical baseline; serial and recipe values share their horizontal origin.
Current-run summary has labeled Pass/Fail/Review counts, a semantic stacked chart and explicit yield denominator.
A dense summary keeps the chart contained when alarms compress the minimum-height window. Start/Stop remain pinned.
render_defects_fixed: Qt maps an absent percentage to undefined; empty yield now checks the denominator and finite value instead of rendering NaN%.
An alarm could compress the bottom row to 88 pixels; the summary now combines counts/yield and hides redundant footer/legend rows in that dense case.

accounting.pass: No defect detected with confirmed saved evidence.
accounting.fail: Defect detected with confirmed saved evidence; distinct from the latched alarm count.
accounting.review: Needs review with confirmed saved evidence; never added to Pass.
accounting.yield: 100 * Pass / (Pass + Fail + Review); an empty denominator is shown as a dash.
accounting.excluded: Pending, uninspected, counting-only and evidence-failed cycles.
accounting.lifetime: Counters are maintained at exact-once lifecycle settlement, survive Stop/recovery in the same run and reset on new Start. No derivation from the bounded event log or retained result history.
accounting.alarm: Existing latched defect accounting is unchanged, including its behavior when evidence fails.

audit.platform_verdict: Pass for inspected paths: native Qt controls, consistent setup geometry, contained chart, direct monitoring controls and preserved menus/lock behavior.

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.evidence: Text equivalents for every count, explicit yield formula, chart accessibility name, focus/input conventions preserved. Full Narrator and user text-scale acceptance remain unverified.

dimensions.name: Performance
dimensions.evidence: Constant-size outcome counters and three chart segments; no plotting dependency, history scan, new polling timer or frame transport. No new endurance/latency benchmark claimed.

dimensions.name: Theming
dimensions.evidence: All new surfaces/text/chart colors use the existing semantic tokens. Light/dark renders and existing palette contrast checks cover the applied vocabulary.

dimensions.name: Desktop conformance
dimensions.evidence: Standard label/value/action rows, Qt inputs and menus; pinning and lock semantics preserved. Summary is read-only and does not change verdicts or models.

dimensions.name: Window adaptivity
dimensions.evidence: 960x640, 1280x800 and 1440x900; long specimen strings, empty/populated summaries and short-window latched alarms. OS DPI/large-font testing remains workstation acceptance.

remaining_findings.issue: The established fixed logical-pixel font/control sizing has no explicit user text-scale control.
remaining_findings.impact: Large-text users may need additional accommodation beyond automatic Qt DPI scaling.
remaining_findings.recommendation: Validate target Windows DPI/text settings and Narrator; use impeccable adapt/harden if clipping or reading-order defects are observed.

intentional_tradeoffs: The dense summary leaves pending/uninspected totals in Monitoring control; its chart description and yield tooltip retain the denominator explanation.
The event log narrows beside the summary and elides detail text; hover retains the full detail and cycle numbers remain in the event model.

verification.data: Populated renders use an explicitly labeled synthetic lifecycle ledger. No physical camera, model inference or real evidence files were used for visual QA.
verification.regressions: Missing evidence, duplicate settlement, out-of-order outcomes, pending timeout, cumulative totals beyond 600 cycles, new-run reset and native top-card/chart geometry.
verification.runtime_warnings: No QML warnings in the native scenario renders or geometry tests.
